task: Copyedit this entrance notice for a fictional hall only if it has a genuine clarity or correctness problem. Its practical explanation and semicolon are useful, not automatic editing targets. Keep it short enough to read on arrival and return it unchanged if it already works.
input: Please leave wet coats on the rail inside the entrance, where the mat catches drips; dry coats may be hung in the cloakroom. The rail is not supervised, so keep valuables with you. If no hanger is free, ask a steward for another rather than putting a wet coat on a chair.
